Batch crawl where one seed URL returns 404 error

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import batch_crawl, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_depth=1, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    urls = ["https://example.com/good_seed", "https://example.com/bad_seed"]
    result = await batch_crawl(engine, urls)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
